description: Mock cross-institutional sources containing subtle discrepancies, omissions, and outdated application deadlines for demonstration.

sources.title: Admissions Merit Scholarship Bulletin
sources.text: Merit STEM Scholarship Program: Applicants must demonstrate academic excellence with a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.50 and maintain full-time undergraduate enrollment (at least 12 credit hours per term). The award provides $5,000 disbursed on a semester-by-semester basis directly to university tuition and student fees. For household need verification, students must submit completed 2024 Federal Tax Returns to the financial aid portal prior to June 1.

sources.title: Financial Aid Verification Requirements FAQ
sources.text: Financial Aid Verification: All merit and need-based applicants must maintain a 3.50 GPA across consecutive terms. To verify household income eligibility for scholarship assistance, applicants must upload their parents' official 2025 W-2 Wage and Tax Statements. Documents submitted via postal mail or unencrypted email will be rejected immediately.

sources.title: Archived Departmental Application Portal
sources.text: STEM Excellence Award Portal: The application cycle for the 2023-2024 academic year concluded on March 15, 2023. Late submissions are not evaluated under any circumstances. Inquiries regarding past cohorts may be directed to archive-stem@university.edu.

structured_summary.fact: Eligibility requires a minimum 3.5 GPA and active full-time enrollment.
Awards provide $5,000 disbursed per semester directly to tuition accounts.
